title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Auditorium on 1969-06-27

ai_review.summary: Early‑era gems like a sprawling Casey Jones and steel‑pedal Dire Wolf shine on this mostly clear soundboard capture despite minor audio quirks.
ai_review.review: The show offers a fascinating glimpse of the Dead in their formative stage, highlighted by an unusually long, trippy intro to Casey Jones, a Jerry steel‑pedal‑enhanced Dire Wolf, and a surprisingly organic Dark Star jam. The soundboard source is generally clean, though reviewers note a few minor anomalies that don’t detract from the overall listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with rare early versions of key songs outweighs only modest recording imperfections; three detailed, mostly positive reviews give a reliable basis for rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced soundboard feed, but reviewers mention minor sound problems/anomalies that are noticeable in parts of the set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑period show feels like a work‑in‑progress, with experimental intros and slower jams that showcase the band's evolution rather than polished set pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for steel pedal work on Dire Wolf and dominant presence on Baby Blue; guitar tone noted as solid.
band_member_comments.Bob: His vocals on Dire Wolf are highlighted as a fitting country‑style contribution.
